svg.title: High-Ticket Authorized-Dealer Launch Sequence
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-high-ticket-dealer-launch-sequence; chapter number: 1; chart type: process_flow; title: High-Ticket Authorized-Dealer Launch Sequence; subtitle: From keyword validation to Google Shopping on $1,000-plus US-brand products; caption: Authorized-dealer operators list $1,000-plus products from established US brands, collect payment first, and let the supplier ship. Kenny's store reached about $207,953 in a month on $4,376.72 of ad spend.; assumptions note: Step order follows the research mechanics practitioners describe. Realistic net margin is 15-20% of gross revenue per Joe Verschoor; MAP compliance tops out near 90% per built with ali.; note: Sources: Joe Verschoor [uxvzRhKmdXU @ 00:04:18; 5jY7d_1m1t0 @ 00:06:13], built with ali [pbk_t9e4Xpo @ 00:11:56; Mf4bZiQ2-Fc @ 00:16:02], Ecommerce Paradise [EaAeDMJIPLQ @ 00:02:06], Peak Flow Media [YmrOjrklnxM @ 00:10:02], Asonjf [91zki-xXArY @ 00:37:42].; stages: step: 01; label: Validate demand; value: Step 1; detail: Check WordStream or Semrush for high search volume plus low keyword difficulty; drop anything seasonal or under $1,000.; step: 02; label: Benchmark online-only dealers; value: Step 2; detail: Search 'buy [brand] [product]' in the Shopping tab and rule out dealers with physical locations or 'appointment required'.; step: 03; label: Confirm strict MAP; value: Step 3; detail: Compare the identical model and size across sellers; expect about 90% compliance at best.; step: 04; label: Price dispute exposure into margin; value: Step 4; detail: Load chargeback, restocking, return-shipping and labor-warranty costs into each brand's margin before listing it.; step: 05; label: Launch on Google Shopping; value: Step 5; detail: Bid bottom-of-funnel terms first, such as 'Samsung TV 36 in', and push Meta to remarketing.
